scope: Independent source-only review of native image/loader/editor risks already surfaced in TUI, and exact JavaScript eval hashing/finally behavior. No application execution or tests.
findings: TUI-228 native VP8L dimensions use chunk-length/signature bytes instead of dimension bytes; direct row calculation can divide by zero, overflow or narrow.
TUI-230 empty public spinner frames cause modulo zero; public option path observed, no production with_options caller established.
TUI-255 completion preserves marker text but clears payload registry; it also appends completion space after the entire suffix.
TUI-253 insert_cursor_marker treats '[' as an escape final byte and can count or split SGR parameters; focused selection/placeholder render calls this helper.
MISC-042 an abort rejection from inner finally replaces an earlier propagating error; MISC-045 JSON.stringify integer-key ordering/number serialization governs the eventual hash.
